unlisted_practices: Preserve clear human answerability for interpretive and relational judgments when deploying patient-facing medical AI.
Do not deploy patient-facing medical AI as a substitute for relational caregiving, especially in contexts of vulnerability, dependence, and communicative ambiguity.
Design governance and clinical workflow so that responsibility is not diffused or fragmented between clinicians, developers, and AI in hybrid care models.
Supplement ethics-by-design with ongoing, context-embedded moral deliberation at the point of care rather than one-time design-stage compliance.

screen.reason: This is a conceptual, philosophical, and normative commentary discussing the moral limits of medical AI and patient-facing caregiving.
